verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਸੁੰਦਰਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਛਬਿ ਕੈ ਛਬੀਲੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: joiee pria bhaavai taeh su(n)dharataa kai suhaavai soiee su(n)dharee kahaavai chhab kai chhabeelee hai ||

en.bdb: The female living being (jeev Istri) who has found favour with the True Guru Master the manifest form of the Lord, becomes virtuous and praiseworthy due to the blessing of spiritual beauty to her. That truly is called the beauty.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਾਨਕ ਬਧੂ ਬਨਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਰੰਗ ਮੈ ਰੰਗੀਲੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: joiee pria bhaavai taeh baanak badhoo banaavai soiee banitaa kahaavai ra(n)g mai ra(n)geelee hai ||

en.bdb: She who is loved by her beloved master, is made into a highly adorable bride by Him. One who is ever engrossed in the hue of Lord's meditation is truly a blessed married woman.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਬੈ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਪੁਜਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੀਲ ਕੈ ਸੁਸੀਲੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: joiee pria bhaavai taa kee sabai kaamanaa pujaavai soiee kaamanee kahaavai seel kai suseelee hai ||

en.bdb: The (seeker) female living being who gains the favour of her beloved master has all her desires fulfilled by Him. By virtue of her superior nature, she is well behaved and that makes her famous as beautiful lady in the true sense.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਲੈ ਪੀਆਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਨੀ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸੀਲੀ ਹੈ ॥੨੦੯॥
verses.translit_en: joiee pria bhaavai taeh prem ras lai peeaavai soiee premanee kahaavai rasik raseelee hai ||209||

en.bdb: The seeker woman who is liked by dear True Guru, she is blessed with relishing the Nam elixir of Lord's love. One who drinks deep the divine elixir is loved one in the true sense. (209)
